messages.subject: Re: FigTree "Scale Factor" equivalent?
messages.body_plain:
When I use `ggtree(myTree, mrsd="2014-01-01") + theme_tree2()` my tree gets truncated because the dates extend into the BCE. Manually controlling the limits of the x-axis does not resolve the issue.

Here is the tree without the mrsd:

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-Zzdbfjh7gvk/V075054o5tI/AAAAAAAAFkY/p-eD_eJb9-ImZZoFl9MeixEvK3nCv2G-QCLcB/s1600/woutMRSD.jpeg>

Here it is using an 'mrsd':

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-GSwSC4APn48/V0759-NM1vI/AAAAAAAAFkc/wXaq9ESJBxIz1XeGR6qO_w2ZzfV51Wn_QCLcB/s1600/wMRSD.jpeg>

And here it is when I add `scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-500, 2500))`:

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-e0i5C2uMCmc/V076HcswMQI/AAAAAAAAFkg/7hCVD1xuRzglnb0Xd00pReDT9DiWZDLiACLcB/s1600/man.jpeg>

Is there a way to get those basal branches of the tree to show up with the time scale?

I'm especially interested in the band outside the circular diagram that indicates family, and the annotation of family as well.  I'm wondering - does ggtree have any facilities for bands and textual annotations such as these?

thanks,
alex

messages.subject: Failing to generate matrix with gheatmap
messages.subject_clean: Failing to generate matrix with gheatmap
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to use your gheatmap function to visualize a tree with associated matrix. I am a relative beginner to R. Your example code works properly on my system, but when I use my data I can generate the tree, but when I call gheatmap I get the following error:

> gheatmap(p, heatdata, offset=2, width=0.5)

Error in seq.default(h[1], h[2], length.out = n) :

  'to' cannot be NA, NaN or infinite

I find R error messages to be very unhelpful, so I am at a loss how to troubleshoot this. I have tried loading both categorical (text) and numeric data, I get the same errors for both. Is there something I’m missing regarding table or data format? Attached are my input files and below is the full code I am trying to run. Any advice would be much appreciated.

Thank you and best regards,

Mark Evans

library("ggtree", lib.loc="/usr/local/lib/R/3.3/site-library")

library("dplyr")

library(readr)

library("colorspace")

tree <- read.tree("ggtree_test_tree.nwk")

annot<-read_tsv("ggtree_test_annotation.txt",col_names=c("XPA","HCfam"))

hc <- lapply(distinct(select(annot,HCfam)),as.character)$HCfam

hc_cls<-list()

for(x in 1:length(hc))

{

   chain<-hc[x]

   hc_cls[[chain]] <- lapply(select(filter(annot,HCfam==chain),XPA),as.character)$XPA

}

tree <- groupOTU(tree, hc_cls)

heatdata <- read_tsv("ggtree_test_annotation.txt",col_names=c("XPA","HCfam"))

p<-ggtree(tree, aes(color=group)) +

     geom_tiplab(size=3) +

     scale_color_manual(values=c("black", rainbow_hcl(length(hc))), labels=c(hc), name="Heavy Chain Family") +

     theme(legend.position="left", legend.key=element_rect(color="White"))

gheatmap(p, heatdata, offset=2, width=0.5)

messages.subject: Re: Rotate text in gheatmap
messages.body_plain:
I have a tree that is grouped and colored by this:

annot_tree <- groupOTU(hc_tree, hc_cls, group_name="hcfamily")

and is then associated with a matrix, as in your advanced annotation example. I am able to correctly display the combined result. However, when I try to then rotate the matrix column labels as described in this post, I get the following error:

"Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'hcfamily' not found"

Specifically the code is:
> hm<-gheatmap(p, clean_data, offset=1.5, width=0.5)+ theme(legend.position="none") + geom_text2(aes(color=hcfamily, label=HCfam), hjust=-4, vjust=0.6, size=3)
> df = get_heatmap_column_position(hm,by="bottom")
> hm + geom_text(data=df, aes(x,y,label=label), nudge_y = -1, angle=45)
"Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'hcfamily' not found"

Any suggestions would be appreciated, thank you.

-Mark
